title: BACKND Base probability (CDN gacha data)
summary: CDN-delivered probability cards (gacha) via Backend.CDN.Probability: list probability tables, fetch probability content, and draw (lotto one-time or by number). Used for gacha/draw odds distributed and managed in the console.
capabilities: route gacha/probability questions to the CDN probability family
distinguish a one-time draw from a draw-by-number
relate probability cards to charts (both under Backend.CDN)
prerequisites: Probability tables and files are registered/selected in the console
common_pitfalls: Expecting probabilities without a selected probability file (excluded from list)
Implementing draw odds client-side instead of using console-managed cards
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route before generating gacha/draw code.
Keep odds authoritative in console-managed probability cards; verify draw APIs upstream.
public_notes: Probability cards are CDN-distributed under Backend.CDN.Probability.
Draw odds should be server/console-authoritative, not client-defined.
